items.titleZh: 汉密尔顿为新加坡大奖赛策略失误承担责任
items.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿因未在虚拟安全车下进站，导致新加坡大奖赛策略失误，从而失去了领奖台，他承担了责任。

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton takes blame for poor Singapore GP strategy
detailZh: 汉密尔顿为新加坡大奖赛策略失误承担责任
策略失误让汉密尔顿在滨海湾赛道的大奖赛中失去了领奖台，排名第六 - 他承担了责任。
汉密尔顿已经对他在一级方程式新加坡大奖赛中的策略承担责任，由于未在虚拟安全车下进站的决定，他付出了高昂的代价。
在比赛第39圈，由于疑似离合器问题，拉塞尔·斯特罗尔被要求停车，虚拟安全车被赛事控制部门投入使用。
在那个阶段，汉密尔顿已经用软胎完成了21圈，而勒克莱尔正在进行15圈的普通轮胎赛段——但只有摩纳哥车手充分利用了虚拟安全车（VSC）进行了一次便宜的第二次进站。
排名第二和第三的法拉利车队本可以轻松地双车并排进站，因为它们之间相差4.4秒，并且在VSC实施时正在通过10-11弯道。
事实上，是汉密尔顿自己决定继续用软胎跑完44圈的超长赛段。这失败了，因为他跌到了第六位，甚至落后于因为慢漏气而不得不在VSC后停车的奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，兰多·诺里斯，麦克拉伦
七届世界冠军在终点线前落后队友勒克莱尔近46秒，因此他的战术决策因此让他损失了大约41.5秒。
“对不起，孩子们，”汉密尔顿在赛后通过无线电说。 “今天我因为那个策略让你们失望了。是我的决定，我让我们失去了宝贵的积分。我会在下一场比赛中尽力弥补。不过，维修区的工作做得很好。”
赛车工程师卡洛·桑蒂回复道：“明白了，谢谢你，刘易斯。”
汉密尔顿的糟糕成绩意味着他在车手积分榜上领先第四名的维斯塔潘的优势已经缩小到8分，因为荷兰人在新加坡大奖赛上获得了个人首胜。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton takes blame for poor Singapore GP strategy
Strategy cost Hamilton the podium at Marina Bay as he fell to sixth – and he shouldered the blame
Lewis Hamilton has taken responsibility for his strategy in Formula 1’s Singapore Grand Prix, after a decision not to pit under a virtual safety car cost him dear.
The VSC was called into action by race control on lap 39 when Lance Stroll pulled aside due to a suspected clutch issue in his Aston Martin.

At that stage of the race, Hamilton had already done 21 laps on softs, while Leclerc was on a 15-lap medium stint – but it was the Monegasque only who made the most of the VSC for a cheap second pitstop.
The Ferraris, which were running second and third, could easily have been double-stacked given they were 4.4 seconds apart and going through Turns 10-11 when the VSC was enforced.

As it happens, it was Hamilton himself who decided to stay out for a mammoth 44-lap stint on softs. This was a failure, as he collapsed to sixth, even behind Oscar Piastri, who had to stop after the VSC due to a slow puncture.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren
The seven-time world champion was nearly 46 seconds down on team-mate Leclerc on the chequered flag, with his tactical call therefore costing him about 41.5 seconds.

“Sorry, boys,” Hamilton said on the radio after the race. “I let you down today with that strategy. My call, and I lost us valuable points. I’ll try and make up for it in the next one. Great job with the pitstop though.”
Racing engineer Carlo Santi replied: “Understood, thank you Lewis.”
Hamilton’s poor result means his advantage over fourth-placed Max Verstappen in the drivers’ standings has dwindled to eight points, following the Dutchman’s maiden Singapore Grand Prix victory.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘打破新加坡大奖赛冠军荒 汉密尔顿策略失误
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘赢得新加坡大奖赛冠军，法拉利因策略失误错失双料领奖台。
items.originalTitle: Verstappen breaks Singapore win drought while Hamilton nosedives
detailZh: 维斯塔潘赢得新加坡大奖赛冠军，法拉利因策略失误错失双料领奖台。
周六的短道赛冠军维斯塔潘在整个周末都表现出色，他在起跑线和开场几圈中成功抵御了查尔斯·勒克莱尔的挑战，并逐渐扩大了领先优势，尤其是在第一次进站的时间点上。
随着维斯塔潘延长了他的第一圈，注意力转向了已经进站的法拉利。
勒克莱尔在维修区中保持了位置，但这让他转到了中胎，而此时汉密尔顿则在后面紧追不舍，使用的是更快的高速胎。
汉密尔顿首先在车队无线电中抱怨在单圈中失去了两秒，然后坚持说“我需要用这个速度，伙计。”
但法拉利没有下令改变位置，勒克莱尔最终开始缩小差距，直到第62圈的第39圈虚拟安全车给了领先车辆一个停下的机会。
勒克莱尔利用了这个机会，换上了用过的软胎，但汉密尔顿继续使用他的软胎，获得了赛道位置，但最终在轮胎年龄上处于21圈的劣势。
当法拉利犹豫是否要为汉密尔顿进站时——这位七届冠军询问他是否可以延长到C计划，这是一个单站策略时——它这样做的时间窗口很快就消失了。勒克莱尔要求法拉利不要浪费时间，因为他追上了姐妹车，汉密尔顿也相应地遵守了，在第48圈的5号弯道处让车。
勒克莱尔在最后几圈将差距缩短了一半，但最终还是以7.335秒的差距落后于维斯塔潘，维斯塔潘在最后时刻最大的麻烦是车手与车队无线电通信失败，以及从最后一个弯道出来的一个失误。
因此，在最后几圈，人们的注意力转向了汉密尔顿会跌落到什么位置。
到第54圈时，他已经落后于兰多·诺里斯和基米·安东内利，在下一圈开始时，汉密尔顿试图在诺里斯的外侧坚持到底，进入第一个弯道，结果开到了跑道上，破坏了麦克拉伦的线路，这也导致了它偏离了赛道。
这给了安东内利超过诺里斯的机会，在那一圈结束前，世界冠军领跑者也超过了汉密尔顿，夺得了第三名，诺里斯在下一圈的10号弯左转处最终超过了汉密尔顿。
汉密尔顿的低迷在比赛最后三分之一时达到顶峰，当时奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂里因为慢漏气而落后，在倒数第二圈超越了他，赛后汉密尔顿向法拉利道歉，为自己的坚持留在赛道上的请求表示歉意。
“对不起，孩子们，今天是我那个策略让你们失望了。我的决定，”他说。
皮亚斯蒂里以第五名的成绩完成比赛，比队友诺里斯慢了九秒，诺里斯在最后几圈被要求谨慎驾驶，因为麦凯轮车队发现了一个潜在的传感器问题。
利安姆·劳森为小红牛车队又完成了一场出色的比赛，以第七名的成绩结束，比奥迪车队的尼科·胡肯伯格快了1.7秒，胡肯伯格在最后几圈阻止了乔治·拉塞尔的梅赛德斯赛车，而拉塞尔是从第19位起步的。
哈贾尔是另一位处于恢复状态的驾驶员。从赛道后部 - 在比赛开始时，他是维修区最后一排三辆车中的最后一辆 - 红牛车手一路冲到了第10位，在最后五圈中超过了阿尔卑斯车队第七位发车的皮埃尔·加斯利，获得了最后一个积分。
DNS：兰斯·斯特罗尔（阿斯顿·马丁）、弗朗哥·科拉平托（阿尔卑斯）、加布里埃尔·博托莱托（奥迪）
detailEn: Max Verstappen claimed his first Singapore Grand Prix win as Ferrari squandered a double-podium by fumbling Lewis Hamilton's strategy.

Saturday's sprint race winner Verstappen had been the class of the field through the weekend and, having resisted Charles Leclerc off the line and through the opening laps, steadily increased his advantage - particularly around the timing of the first pitstops.
As Verstappen extended his first stint, attention instead turned to the Ferraris once both of them had pitted.
Leclerc retained position through these stops, but that took him onto the medium compound tyre - with Hamilton then in hot pursuit and on the faster soft tyre.
Hamilton complained over the team radio first of losing two seconds on one lap and then insisting "I need to use this speed, mate".
But Ferrari did not order a change of positions and Leclerc did eventually begin to eke out a gap until a virtual safety car on lap 39 of 62 afforded the leading cars a chance to stop.
Leclerc did take advantage of that by swapping onto a used set of soft tyres but Hamilton stayed out on his soft tyres, gaining track position but ending up at a 21-lap tyre-age disadvantage.

As Ferrari dithered over whether to pit Hamilton - with the seven-time champion asking whether he could extend onto Plan C, considered to be a one-stop strategy - its window to do so soon disappeared. Leclerc asked Ferrari not to lose time as he caught the sister car and Hamilton duly obliged, moving over at Turn 5 on lap 48.

Leclerc did halve the gap to Verstappen in the closing laps but still ended up 7.335s down at the flag, with Verstappen's biggest dramas late on being a failure of his driver-to-team radio and a wide moment out of the final corner.
Attention in the final laps therefore turned to how far down the order Hamilton would tumble.

By lap 54 he had Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli on his tail, and at the start of the following lap Hamilton tried to stick it out around the outside of Norris into the first corner, taking to the run-off as a result and compromising the line of the McLaren, which also ran off-track.

That allowed Antonelli to sweep past Norris and before the end of the lap the world championship leader had also cleared Hamilton to claim third place, with Norris finally working his way past Hamilton at the Turn 10 left-hander the following lap.

Hamilton's slump was completed when Oscar Piastri - who'd suffered a slow-puncture in the final third of the race - passed him on the penultimate lap, with Hamilton apologising to Ferrari post-race for his request to stay out.
"Sorry boys I let you down today with that strategy. My call," he said.
Piastri was fifth, nine seconds behind team-mate Norris, who was asked to drive with caution in the final laps after McLaren spotted a potential sensor issue.

Liam Lawson drove another exemplary race to seventh for Racing Bulls, finishing 1.7s ahead of Audi's Nico Hulkenberg - who held the second Mercedes of George Russell off in the closing laps, Russell having started 19th.

Isack Hadjar was another driver on a recovery charge. From the back of the field - he was last in line of the three cars at the end of the pitlane at the start of the race - the Red Bull driver made it through to 10th, passing Alpine's seventh-place starter Pierre Gasly for the final point inside the final five laps.
DNF: Lance Stroll (Aston Martin), Franco Colapinto (Alpine), Gabriel Bortoleto (Audi)

基米·安东内利利用了汉密尔顿和迈凯轮的兰多·诺里斯在后期展开的激烈对抗的机会，在后者后期的轮胎磨损严重的情况下，获得了第三名，并在车手积分榜上以102分的优势领先乔治·拉塞尔。

detailEn: Singapore GP: Max Verstappen wins event for first time in F1 career ahead of Charles Leclerc as Lewis Hamilton apologises for strategy

Red Bull's Max Verstappen dominated the Singapore Grand Prix with a lights-to-flag victory; Charles Leclerc was second and Kimi Antonelli third; Lewis Hamilton apologised for a messy race strategically that saw him finish down in sixth
Max Verstappen wins the Singapore Grand Prix for the first time

Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix for the first time in his Formula 1 career with a dominant victory, while Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton endured a messy strategic race to tumble off the podium late on.

Verstappen led every lap on his way to a second consecutive win despite being unable to communicate with the team due to a radio problem, but it did not affect him as he held off an early challenge from Ferrari's Charles Leclerc who eventually finished seven seconds behind in second.

Kimi Antonelli took advantage of an elbows-out battle late on between Hamilton and McLaren's Lando Norris, with the seven-time world champion on old tyres in the latter stages, to take third and extend his lead over George Russell to 102 points in the Drivers' Championship.

detailZh: F1新加坡大奖赛：维斯塔潘在滨海湾街道赛道实现双冠
维斯塔潘在周六的冲刺赛中获胜，并在有争议的费拉利策略中加分
维斯塔潘首次赢得F1新加坡大奖赛，领跑查尔斯·勒克莱尔和基米·安东内利冲过终点线。
维斯塔潘在比赛中克服了勒克莱尔的早期挑战，并在剩余的比赛中证明了自己更快
策略让汉密尔顿付出了代价，让安东内利得以站在领奖台上，进一步扩大了他的积分领先优势——以至于他在奥斯汀将有机会首次锁定冠军。主要对手和梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔从第19位发车，艰难地拼到了第9位。
维特斯坦在发车时成功抵挡住了勒克莱尔
一排发车的查尔斯·勒克莱尔在滨海湾街道赛道上发车表现最佳，但杆位发车的维特斯坦在第一弯道险些被超越。尽管汉密尔顿没有像对手那样使用软胎，他仍然保持了第三的位置，后面跟着安东内利、兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里——车手排名与发车位次保持不变。
勒克莱尔一直紧随维特斯坦，直到加布里埃尔·博尔特莱托在起跑/终点直道上因疑似变速箱问题停车，导致虚拟安全车介入，但没有人进站，奥迪可能阻碍了维修区的出口。
到第11圈时，汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔的差距达到了3秒，英国人紧随其后的是安东内利和麦克拉伦车队；然而，那时摩纳哥人开始持续地比维斯塔潘慢半秒一圈。在第18圈时，他的差距达到了4秒。
那时，尽管汉密尔顿是从中性胎起步，但他却是第一个进站的车手，换上了软胎；在上一个回合中，英国人的圈速比维斯塔潘慢了1.8秒，比勒克莱尔慢了1.4秒。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
安东内利在第23圈时是第一个从软胎切换到中性胎的领跑者；勒克莱尔在下一圈也做了同样的操作，并且险些在队友法拉利车手之前重新加入比赛，而他的队友对此并不高兴，他在无线电中多次抱怨。
“我感觉我的脚之间有东西在漏，”安东内利在32圈时报告——但梅赛德斯并不担心——因为维斯塔潘进站维修，安全地重新加入比赛并领跑。
在第35圈，红牛车手比勒克莱尔领先了5秒；汉密尔顿落后7秒，安东内利落后11秒，诺里斯和皮亚斯特里的麦拉伦车队分别落后领跑者21秒和28秒，澳大利亚车手在维修区停留了4.2秒。
在第39圈，由于兰斯·斯特罗尔疑似离合器问题被拉到一边，比赛被虚拟安全车中断；勒克莱尔和安东内利充分利用了这个机会，从中性胎换回软胎，但汉密尔顿却有趣地继续使用磨损的软胎。
“伙计，我的刹车根本不管用！我直接冲出去了！踏板太长了！”愤怒的安东内利喊道，而皮亚斯特里在第41圈因为慢漏气再次进站。
从第二次维修区进站落后汉密尔顿10秒后，勒克莱尔仅用五圈就追上了队友，并迅速超越了他。在剩余15圈中，他落后于遇到无线电问题的维斯塔潘15秒。
勒克莱尔在62圈的第55圈将劣势缩小到8.3秒，之后差距一直保持在那个水平，维斯塔潘以7.3秒的优势轻松获胜。
汉密尔顿在44圈的软胎耐久赛中表现挣扎，受到诺里斯的压迫，但安东内利收拾了残局，在前往领奖台的路上超越了这两辆赛车。这位七届世界冠军在检旗后排名第六，落后于皮亚斯特里。
由于动力单元网格下降，从第19位起步的拉塞尔稳步提升，尽管速度较慢，但在进站后未能突破前十。
梅赛德斯车手是最后一位更换轮胎的，他在VSC介入期间更换轮胎，但时机不对，中性化在他进入维修区后不久就结束了。
因此，拉塞尔在利亚姆·劳森、尼科·胡肯伯格和皮埃尔·加斯利之后重新加入比赛，最终超越阿尔卑斯车队，以第九名的成绩结束。
对于加斯利来说，这真是一个令人失望的一天，他在排位赛中表现出色，获得了第七名，但在起跑时失去了两个位置，被劳森和胡肯伯格超越，最终从前十名中掉出，让伊萨克·哈吉尔受益。这位红牛的法国人在维修区起跑中得到了一分，此前他在周六遭遇了机械故障的噩梦。
奥利弗·贝尔曼的强劲驾驶，与哈斯车队的队友埃斯特班·奥康的惊心动魄的轮对轮赛车，以及在卡洛斯·塞恩斯内线超车的勇敢尝试，最终在第十二名中未能得到回报，领先于这位法国人和西班牙人。阿维德·林德布拉德、费尔南多·阿隆索和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯随后而来。
瓦尔特里·博塔斯几乎被他的凯迪拉克车队队友超越，而阿尔皮讷的弗朗哥·科拉平托因疑似传动系统问题退赛。亚历山大·阿隆索也未能完成比赛。
detailEn: F1 Singapore GP: Max Verstappen dominates for Marina Bay double
Verstappen triumphed at the Marina Bay Street Circuit to add to his Saturday sprint amid a debatable strategy from Ferrari
Max Verstappen won Formula 1’s Singapore Grand Prix for the first time, leading Charles Leclerc and Kimi Antonelli to the chequered flag.
Verstappen withstood an early challenge from Leclerc and proved quicker over the remainder of the race.

Strategy cost Lewis Hamilton dear, allowing Antonelli to finish on the podium and further extend his championship lead – to the extent that he will get a first chance to clinch the title in Austin. Main rival and Mercedes team-mate George Russell fought to a lowly ninth from 19th on the grid.
Verstappen holds off Leclerc at lights out

Front-row starter Charles Leclerc had the best getaway at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, but polesitter Verstappen ever so narrowly held him off in Turn 1. Lewis Hamilton maintained third place despite using the medium compound unlike his rivals on softs, followed by Antonelli, Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri – the order of the top six on the grid was unchanged.

Leclerc remained within touching distance of Verstappen until Gabriel Bortoleto stopped on the start/finish straight with a suspected gearbox issue, causing a virtual safety car intervention, but nobody pitted with the Audi potentially blocking the pitlane exit.

By lap 11, Hamilton’s deficit to Leclerc had reached three seconds, with the Briton closely followed by Antonelli and the McLarens; however, that was when the Monegasque started consistently lapping half a second slower than Verstappen. On lap 18, he was four seconds down.

That was when, despite having started on mediums, Hamilton was the first driver to pit, switching to softs; on the previous tour, the Briton had lapped 1.8s slower than Verstappen and 1.4s slower than Leclerc.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

Antonelli was the first frontrunner to move from softs to mediums on lap 23; Leclerc did likewise on the next tour and narrowly rejoined ahead of his Ferrari team-mate, who was not overly happy to be stuck behind – he complained several times on the radio.
“I feel something leaking between my feet,” Antonelli reported on lap 32 – but Mercedes wasn’t concerned – as Verstappen pitted, safely rejoining in the lead.

On lap 35, the Red Bull racer enjoyed a five-second advantage over Leclerc; Hamilton was seven seconds down, Antonelli 11s adrift, with the McLarens of Norris and Piastri respectively 21s and 28s away from the leader, after a 4.2s stop for the Australian.

The race was neutralised by the virtual safety car on lap 39 as Lance Stroll pulled aside with a suspected clutch issue; Leclerc and Antonelli made the most of it to switch back from mediums to softs, but Hamilton interestingly stayed out on used softs.
“Mate, I have no f***ing brakes! I just went straight! The pedal was so long!” shouted an aggrieved Antonelli, as Piastri pitted again on lap 41 due to a slow puncture.

Having rejoined from his second pitstop 10 seconds behind Hamilton, Leclerc caught his team-mate in just five laps and swiftly overtook him. He was 15 seconds down on Verstappen, who was experiencing radio issues, with 15 laps remaining.
Leclerc brought his deficit down to 8.3 seconds on lap 55 of 62, after which it just hovered around hat gap, and Verstappen comfortably prevailed by 7.3s.

Struggling on his mammoth 44-lap stint on softs, Hamilton came under pressure from Norris, but Antonelli picked up the pieces, overtaking both cars on his way to the podium. The seven-time world champion collapsed to sixth under the chequered flag, behind Piastri.
Starting from 19th owing to a power unit grid drop, Russell made steady progress through the pack, albeit slow, failing to break into the top 10 before pitstops allowed him to do so.
The Mercedes racer was the last driver to change tyres, doing so during the VSC intervention, but the timing wasn’t right and the neutralisation ended shortly after he entered the pitlane.
Russell therefore rejoined behind Liam Lawson, Nico Hulkenberg and Pierre Gasly, only overtaking the Alpine to finish ninth.

It was an underwhelming day for Gasly, who had qualified an impressive seventh but lost two spots to Lawson and Hulkenberg at the start and eventually dropped out of the top 10 altogether, to Isack Hadjar’s benefit. Red Bull’s Frenchman scored one point from a pitlane start, after a nightmare Saturday when he was struck by mechanical woes.

A punchy drive from Oliver Bearman, with breathtaking wheel-to-wheel racing against Haas team-mate Esteban Ocon and a bold down-the-inside overtake on Carlos Sainz, went unrewarded in 12th place, ahead of the Frenchman and the Spaniard. Arvid Lindblad, Fernando Alonso and Sergio Perez followed.
Valtteri Bottas was nearly lapped by his Cadillac team-mate, while Alpine’s Franco Colapinto retired due to a suspected driveline issue. Alexander Albon also failed to finish the race.

items.originalTitle: Five quick takeaways from Singapore GP
detailZh: 维斯塔潘获得第二场胜利 - 肯米·安东内利延长积分领先。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔、刘易斯·汉密尔顿、马克斯·维斯塔潘、小红牛车队。
小红牛的巴库升级是“好东西”，当被问及目前F1的局势时，麦卡洛恩的奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂里带着一丝微笑说。
无论小红牛在阿塞拜疆的升级是什么，都是好东西。在法拉利和麦卡洛恩作为梅赛德斯的主要挑战者短暂占据领先之后，小红牛改进的小红牛22不仅更快，而且驾驶起来也更可预测。
“无需多言，”马克斯·维斯塔潘说，他向乔治·拉塞尔挑战在巴库的胜利，在马来西亚的巴林大奖赛上以砂质赛道主导了比赛，并在新加坡崎岖的道路上证明了自己高人一等，而新加坡之前是红牛的阿基里斯之踵。
红牛的复兴来得太晚，维斯塔潘无法挑战冠军，但这个多样化的三连赛给了我们一个相当可靠的样本，米尔顿凯恩斯确实回来了，维斯塔潘现在拥有了成为他毁灭性自我的正确工具。
基米·安东内利在周五晚上并不在最佳状态，因为在自由练习和冲刺预赛中都以第七名结束。这位20岁的年轻人把这归咎于他更新的梅赛德斯套件，这个套件据说很难驾驶，并且没有达到红牛和马克斯·维斯塔潘在吉隆坡和新加坡超越他们的期望。
但随着周末在滨海湾的进行，锦标赛领导者与升级后的W17越来越默契，并获得了足以赢得2026年冠军的积分。安东内利不需要在每个比赛中获胜，他只需要在每场大奖赛中最大化可能获得的东西，而去年奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在拥有如此大的优势时，未能做到这一点，当时他是与迈凯轮队友兰多·诺里斯的对手。
历史并非在重演——而一枚处女冠只是时间问题。
梅赛德斯会怎么做？
尽管安东内利随着周末的进行，新的套件逐渐提升了他的表现，但梅赛德斯仍然担心这次升级并没有完全实现预期的效果。在巴库，维斯塔潘被问及他是否认为他能在2026年真正赢得一场比赛，他将银箭的这次升级作为他不会赢得比赛的理由。
这位四次世界冠军声称，尽管红牛的更新让它在巴库更接近梅赛德斯，但差距自然会回到银箭主导时的水平。然而，情况恰恰相反，维斯塔潘自那以后赢得了所有的比赛。
按照目前的情况发展，很容易看出维斯塔潘将会带着这股势头进入2027年，并发起一场强有力的冠军挑战。因此，梅赛德斯必须做出决定，以确保它回归曾经的主导地位，而这需要将所有精力集中在2027年。
当谈到法拉利时，对于意大利球迷来说，情况要么是半空，要么是充满情感。由于没有一致的胜利可以兴奋地庆祝，几乎不可避免地会有关于更换领导层或其他需要改变的事情的讨论。
然而，法拉利在车队积分榜上仍然稳固地排在第二位，与最接近的竞争对手有相当大的差距，尽管梅赛德斯领先太多。如果不是因为红牛的最新升级，斯库德利亚甚至可能在新加坡赢得比赛。是的，又是如果和但是，但仍然……马拉内洛的团队并不像有些人试图宣称的那样糟糕。
当然，与去年相比，已经取得了一些进步，坦白说，根据积分榜排名，只有一支车队做得更好。但当然，红色车队的车迷永远不会满足于这一点。
劳森加强了自己在2027年小红牛车队车位的竞争力
利亚姆·劳森正在做一切必要的事情来保持他在下赛季小红牛车队的席位，即使车队坚称他们并不急于确定阵容。
在周五的官方新闻发布会上，车队负责人艾伦·帕尔曼表示，他正在保留选择权，关于谁将在2027年搭档阿维德·林德布拉德的问题。这位新秀尚未正式确认，但他已经证明了自己的价值。
Formula 2锦标赛领跑者尼古拉·茨洛夫是一个强有力的竞争者。鉴于法恩扎车队作为红牛青训车手通往F1的跳板的传统角色，提拔这位19岁的保加利亚人将非常合理。
然而，劳森正在越来越有说服力地证明他应该留在这里。在新加坡的又一次稳健的驾驶，以第七名的成绩结束，成为其他车队中表现最好的，这进一步巩固了他的主张。
这个成绩标志着他在本赛季16场大奖赛中的第八次进入前七名，并且他的积分达到了令人印象深刻的75分，使他轻松地排在车手积分榜的第九位。
小红牛车队预计将在“未来几周”做出决定。在此之前，劳森所能做的只有继续出色地表现——而且他正在为车队提供保留他的每一个理由。
detailEn: Second win for Max Verstappen - and an extended championship lead for Kimi Antonelli
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
Red Bull's Baku upgrade was "the good stuff"

"Whatever Red Bull's upgrade in Azerbaijan was, it was good stuff," McLaren's Oscar Piastri said with a wry smile when we asked him about the state of play in F1 right now. Following brief spells for Ferrari and McLaren at the top as Mercedes' main challengers, Red Bull's improved RB22 is not only quicker but also more predictable to drive.

"Say no more," said Max Verstappen, as he challenged George Russell to the win in Baku, dominated the Bahrain GP in Malaysia on an abrasive Sepang and also proved a cut above on the bumpy roads of Singapore, which was previously Red Bull's Achilles heel.

Red Bull's resurgence has come too late for Verstappen to challenge for the title, but this diverse triple-header has given us a pretty solid sample size that Milton Keynes is truly back, and Verstappen now has the right tools to be his devastating self.

Kimi Antonelli wasn’t exactly in the best of moods on Friday evening, having finished seventh in both free practice and sprint qualifying. The 20-year-old put it down to his updated Mercedes package, which had supposedly been difficult to drive and not delivered upon expectations with Red Bull and Max Verstappen overtaking them in Sepang and now Singapore.

But as the Marina Bay weekend progressed the championship leader became more at one with his upgraded W17 and delivered the sort of points haul that will win him this 2026 title. Antonelli doesn’t have to win every race, he just needs to maximise what’s possible in every grand prix and that is something Oscar Piastri failed to do when he held such an advantage over McLaren team-mate Lando Norris last year.
History is not repeating itself - and a maiden crown is simply a matter of time.
What does Mercedes do?

Although Antonelli gradually improved with the new package as the weekend progressed, it must still be a worry for Mercedes that this upgrade hasn’t fully delivered what was hoped. In Baku, Verstappen was asked if he thinks he can actually win a race in 2026 and he used this upgrade for the Silver Arrows as a reason for why he won’t.

The four-time world champion claimed that, although Red Bull’s update got it closer to Mercedes in Baku, the gap will naturally go back to what it was when the Silver Arrows was dominant. Yet the opposite has transpired, with Verstappen winning both races since then.

At the way things are going, one could easily see Verstappen carrying this momentum into 2027 and launching a strong title challenge. So Mercedes has decisions to make to ensure it returns to its once dominant form and that entails putting all focus into 2027.

It seems that when it comes to Ferrari, for Italian fans the glass is either half empty or overflowing with emotion. With no consistent wins to celebrate ecstatically, it's almost inevitable that there will be talk about changing the leadership or whatever else there is to change.

Yet Ferrari still holds a solid second place in the constructors' championship, with a considerable margin over its closest rivals, even though Mercedes is too far ahead. If not for Red Bull's latest upgrade, the Scuderia could even have won in Singapore. Yes, it's ifs and buts again, but still... The team from Maranello isn't as bad as some are trying to claim.

Certainly, progress has been made since last year, and frankly, based on the championship standings, only one team has done better. But of course, the red team's fans will never be satisfied with that.
Lawson strengthens his case for a 2027 Racing Bulls seat
Liam Lawson is doing everything he needs to do to hold on to his Racing Bulls seat for next season, even if the team insists it is in "no rush" to settle its line-up.

Speaking in Friday's official press conference, team principal Alan Permane said he was keeping his options open over who would partner Arvid Lindblad in 2027. The rookie has yet to be formally confirmed himself, but he has proven his worth long enough already.

Formula 2 championship frontrunner Nikola Tsolov is a strong contender. Promoting the 19-year-old Bulgarian would make perfect sense given the Faenza outfit's traditional role as a stepping stone to F1 for Red Bull's junior drivers.
Yet Lawson is making an increasingly persuasive case for staying put. Another assured drive to seventh in Singapore, finishing best of the rest, only strengthened his claim.
That result marked his eighth top-seven finish in 16 grands prix this season and took his tally to an impressive 75 points, leaving him comfortably ninth in the drivers' standings.
Racing Bulls expects to make its decision in the "coming weeks". Until then, Lawson can do little more than keep delivering – and he is giving the team every reason to keep him.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯紧追哈姆林顿，仅落后三秒，安东内利紧随其后
items.summaryZh: 诺里斯现在正紧追哈姆林顿，仅落后三秒。安东内利也在追赶。勒克莱尔在无遮挡的赛道上每圈比维斯塔潘快半秒，但不足以缩短13秒的差距。

Norris is reeling in Hamilton now, just three seconds behind. Antonelli coming with him too
Leclerc is about half a second per lap quicker than Verstappen in clear air but doesn't have enough laps to close a 13s gap #F1 #SingaporeGP

items.titleZh: 安东内利再次越界，将被罚5秒
items.summaryZh: 安东内利在新加坡大奖赛中再次越界，将被处以5秒时间罚分。幸运的是，他比皮亚斯特里领先25秒，但这将影响他超越诺里斯的机会。
items.originalTitle: Antonelli exceeds track limits again - that's going to be a five-second time penalty. Fortunately he's 25s ahead of Piastri, but that will hurt his ch...
items.summaryEn: Antonelli exceeds track limits again - that's going to be a five-second time penalty. Fortunately he's 25s ahead of Piastri, but that will hurt his chances of passing and pulling clear of Norris #F1 #SingaporeGP
detailZh: 安东内利在新加坡大奖赛中再次越界 - 那将是一个五秒的时间罚分。幸运的是，他比皮亚斯特里领先25秒，但这将影响他超越诺里斯的机会。
detailEn: Antonelli exceeds track limits again - that's going to be a five-second time penalty. Fortunately he's 25s ahead of Piastri, but that will hurt his chances of passing and pulling clear of Norris #F1 #SingaporeGP
